school.school_name: 横浜スイーツ＆カフェ専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Determine whether a visible Sanko disclosure page has a true FY2026 confirmation form or only a stale latest-public form.
search_queries: 横浜スイーツ＆カフェ専門学校 情報公開
横浜スイーツ＆カフェ専門学校 機関要件確認申請書
steps: Open https://www.sanko.ac.jp/yokohama-sweets/ and the derived disclosure page.
Inspect the disclosure and guidelines pages for the confirmation form anchor.
Observe that the latest target-form candidate is yoshiki2025.pdf with anchor text 2025年度.
Run strict FY2026 discovery and record fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 instead of accepting it.
Run FY2025 control only as proof that the crawler can acquire the latest public form.

reusable_rules: Treat a visible 2025年度/yoshiki2025.pdf form as latest-public evidence, not as FY2026 success.
Surface publication-lag schools separately so the operator can distinguish crawler failure from public-site lag.
Keep the rejection evidence because it explains why no FY2026 document row exists.
anti_patterns: Do not loosen strict mode to accept stale forms.
Do not send schoolinfo, timetable, course-list, or school-guide PDFs to the PDF parser as target candidates.
Do not infer FY2026 from a 2026 disclosure directory when the actual confirmation-form URL or anchor says 2025.

evidence.notes: Windows v136 strict FY2026 rejected this school's visible target form as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025; FY2025 control accepted it.
